name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
description: A credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
simple_description: A government loan program giving up to 35% cash subsidy on loans taken to start a new shop, workshop, or small manufacturing factory.
max_assistance_text: Up to ₹50 Lakhs for Manufacturing, ₹20 Lakhs for Service
benefits: Subsidy up to 35% for Special Categories (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Rural) and 25% for Urban
Subsidy up to 25% for General Category (Rural) and 15% (Urban)
Bank financing for remaining 90-95% of project cost
Manufacturing project support up to ₹50 Lakhs, Service sector up to ₹20 Lakhs
simple_benefits: Government pays 15% to 35% of your total loan as a gift (subsidy)
Bank lends you up to 95% of total project cost
Get up to ₹50 Lakh loan for factories and ₹20 Lakh for service shops
required_documents: Educational Qualification Certificate (8th pass for > ₹10L manufacturing)

application_steps.title: Prepare Business Project Report
application_steps.description: Draft project report showing machinery, operational costs, and income estimates.

application_steps.title: Visit PMEGP e-Portal
application_steps.description: Go to official KVIC PMEGP portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal).

application_steps.title: Fill Online Application Form
application_steps.description: Select implementing agency (KVIC/KVIB/DIC) and enter personal & bank details.

application_steps.title: Upload Scanned Documents
application_steps.description: Upload Aadhaar, caste certificate, photo, and Project Report.

application_steps.title: Track Application & Bank Sanction
application_steps.description: Submit form, receive Application ID, and complete mandatory EDP training.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to SC/ST and Women borrowers for setting up greenfield enterprises.
simple_description: Special bank loan scheme for SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs giving loans from ₹10 Lakh up to ₹1 Crore for new businesses.
max_assistance_text: Bank loan from ₹10 Lakhs up to ₹1 Crore
benefits: Bank loans ranging from ₹10 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore
Composite loan covering capital expenditure and working capital
Repayable in 7 years with maximum 18 months moratorium period
Handholding support through Stand Up India Portal
simple_benefits: Get big loans between ₹10 Lakhs and ₹1 Crore for starting a new business
7 years time to repay loan comfortably with 1.5 years moratorium period
required_documents: SC/ST Category Certificate or Woman Entrepreneur Proof
Business Address Proof / Land / Rent Agreement
Project Report detailing capital expenditure & working capital

application_steps.title: Registration on Standup Mitra Portal
application_steps.description: Visit standupmitra.in and register as borrower.

application_steps.title: Choose Borrower Category & Preferred Bank
application_steps.description: Select category (SC/ST/Woman) and pick bank branch.

application_steps.title: Upload Project Proposal
application_steps.description: Attach business plan, identity proof, and category certificate.

application_steps.title: Bank Processing & Sanction
application_steps.description: Bank evaluates proposal and sanctions loan.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Provides collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Lakh to micro/small enterprises under Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories.
simple_description: No-guarantee bank loans up to ₹10 Lakh for small shopkeepers, artisans, street vendors, and micro-business owners.
max_assistance_text: Up to ₹10 Lakhs collateral-free credit
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for early stage businesses
Kishore: Loans above ₹50,000 and up to ₹5 Lakhs
Tarun: Loans above ₹5 Lakhs and up to ₹10 Lakhs
No collateral / property security required
MUDRA Card for working capital withdrawal
simple_benefits: No property or house security required (collateral-free)
Three loan stages: Shishu (₹50k), Kishore (₹5L), Tarun (₹10L)
Mudra Debit Card for daily working capital
required_documents: Quotations for machinery/items to be purchased

application_steps.title: Select Mudra Loan Category
application_steps.description: Choose Shishu (<=50k), Kishore (50k-5L), or Tarun (5L-10L).

application_steps.title: Apply at JanSamarth Portal or Bank
application_steps.description: Visit jansamarth.in or nearest commercial bank/MFI.

application_steps.title: Submit Application & Quotes
application_steps.description: Submit filled form along with identity proof and machinery price quotes.

application_steps.title: Loan Disbursement
application_steps.description: Bank verifies documents and credits loan to bank account.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
description: Provides holistic end-to-end support to artisans and craftspeople in 18 traditional trades including skill training, toolkit incentives, and low-interest loans.
simple_description: Government scheme for traditional artisans (carpenters, weavers, tailors, blacksmiths) offering free skill training, ₹15,000 toolkit voucher, and 5% cheap loans.
max_assistance_text: ₹15,000 toolkit voucher + ₹3 Lakh credit at 5% interest
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card recognition
Free basic (5-7 days) & advanced (15 days) skill training with ₹500/day stipend
Toolkit incentive of ₹15,000 e-voucher
Collateral-free credit support up to ₹3 Lakhs at 5% concessional interest
simple_benefits: Free Official Vishwakarma Identity Card
Free skill training + ₹500 daily allowance during training
₹15,000 cash voucher for buying tools
Loans up to ₹3 Lakh at super low 5% interest rate

application_steps.title: Visit Nearest CSC Centre
application_steps.description: Go to Common Service Centre with Aadhaar for biometric verification.

application_steps.title: 3-Tier Verification
application_steps.description: Gram Panchayat/ULB verification followed by District Committee screening.

application_steps.title: Download ID & Receive Training
application_steps.description: Download Vishwakarma Certificate and attend skill training.

application_steps.title: Toolkit & Loan Disbursement
application_steps.description: Receive ₹15,000 toolkit voucher and apply for 5% credit tranche.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
description: Facilitates collateral-free credit to Micro and Small Enterprises by providing credit guarantee coverage to banks.
simple_description: Government scheme where government stands as guarantor for micro/small business bank loans up to ₹5 Crore without collateral.
max_assistance_text: Collateral-free credit up to ₹5 Crore
benefits: Guarantee coverage up to 85% for Micro enterprises up to ₹5 Lakhs
Guarantee coverage up to 85% for SC/ST and Women operated enterprises
Loan coverage up to ₹5 Crore without collateral security or third-party guarantee
simple_benefits: Government acts as your guarantor for bank loans up to ₹5 Crore
Up to 85% guarantee cover for women and SC/ST owners
No mortgage of property needed

application_steps.title: Get Udyam MSME Registration
application_steps.description: Register enterprise on udyamregistration.gov.in.

application_steps.title: Apply at Partnered Bank (MLI)
application_steps.description: Submit loan application at commercial bank or NBFC.

application_steps.title: Bank Obtains CGTMSE Cover
application_steps.description: Bank applies directly to CGTMSE portal for credit guarantee cover.

name: PM SVANidhi (Prime Minister Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume livelihoods.
simple_description: Easy collateral-free working capital loan scheme for street vendors starting from ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.
max_assistance_text: Micro loans ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd), ₹50,000 (3rd)
benefits: First tranche collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000
Second tranche loan of ₹20,000 upon timely repayment
Third tranche loan of ₹50,000 upon timely repayment of second tranche
Interest subsidy at 7% per annum credited directly to bank account
Cashback up to ₹1,200 per year on digital transactions
simple_benefits: Get initial ₹10,000 loan without any security deposit
Get higher loans up to ₹50,000 after timely repayment
7% interest discount paid back into your bank account
Cashback bonus for using UPI digital payments
required_documents: Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB (if Certificate not available)

application_steps.title: Check Vending Status / Get LoR
application_steps.description: Verify name in ULB survey list or obtain Letter of Recommendation.

application_steps.title: Apply on PM SVANidhi Portal
application_steps.description: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or apply through Common Service Centre.

application_steps.title: Select Preferred Bank & Loan Amount
application_steps.description: Choose nearby bank branch and apply for 1st tranche loan.

application_steps.title: Loan Disbursement & Digital Onboarding
application_steps.description: Receive loan amount directly into bank account and start digital UPI payments.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NULM (SEP Loan & Subsidy)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
description: Self Employment Programme (SEP) component of NULM providing financial assistance and interest subsidy to urban poor for setting up micro-enterprises.
simple_description: Financial assistance for urban poor, women, and marginalized groups to start micro-businesses with low-interest bank loans up to ₹2 Lakhs per individual.
max_assistance_text: Individual loan up to ₹2 Lakhs, SHG Group loan up to ₹10 Lakhs
benefits: Individual micro-enterprise loan up to ₹2 Lakhs
Self Help Group (SHG) group loan up to ₹10 Lakhs
Interest subsidy over 7% per annum credited to bank account
Special additional 3% interest subsidy for women SHGs
simple_benefits: Get up to ₹2 Lakh loan for starting your own urban shop/business
Interest rate above 7% is paid by government as subsidy
Group loans up to ₹10 Lakh for Women Self-Help Groups
required_documents: Proof of Urban Residence / Ration Card

application_steps.title: Contact NULM City Mission Management Unit
application_steps.description: Approach Municipal Corporation / ULB NULM cell.

application_steps.title: Fill SEP Application Form
application_steps.description: Submit application form along with income proof and project proposal.

application_steps.title: Task Force Committee Approval
application_steps.description: ULB task force verifies eligibility and forwards application to bank.

application_steps.title: Bank Sanction & Interest Subsidy
application_steps.description: Bank disburses loan and interest subsidy is automatically credited.

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM (Mahila Kisan & SHG Micro-Credit)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD)
description: Promotes rural women entrepreneurship through Self Help Groups (SHGs), revolving funds, capital subsidy, and low-interest bank linkage.
simple_description: Government scheme for rural women to form Self-Help Groups and get revolving funds, cheap bank loans, and micro-business support.
max_assistance_text: Revolving Fund ₹15,000 + CIF ₹1.5 Lakhs + Bank Linkage
benefits: Revolving Fund (RF) of ₹15,000 to ₹30,000 per SHG
Community Investment Fund (CIF) up to ₹1.5 Lakhs per SHG
Collateral-free loan linkage up to ₹20 Lakhs for eligible SHGs
Interest subvention reducing interest rate to 4% for prompt repayment
simple_benefits: Free revolving fund grant for Women Self-Help Groups
Low interest bank loans reduced to just 4% interest rate
Collateral-free group loans up to ₹20 Lakhs

application_steps.title: Form or Join Women SHG
application_steps.description: Form 10-15 member rural women SHG with Village Organization (VO).

application_steps.title: Open SHG Bank Account
application_steps.description: Open savings account in commercial or regional rural bank.

application_steps.title: Apply for RF & CIF Grants
application_steps.description: Submit application to Block Program Management Unit (BPMU).

application_steps.title: Bank Credit Linkage
application_steps.description: Receive collateral-free loan linkage for group micro-businesses.

name: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries (SFURTI)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
description: Organizes traditional artisans and industries into clusters to make them competitive and provide long-term sustainability through modern equipment and infrastructure.
simple_description: Government scheme that builds common factory centers, provides modern tools, and marketing help to groups of traditional artisans and rural craft makers.
max_assistance_text: Up to ₹2.5 Crore for Regular Clusters, ₹5 Crore for Major Clusters
benefits: 100% financial assistance for soft interventions (training, exposures, design)
90% grant support for Common Facility Centres (CFCs), machinery, and raw material banks
Up to ₹2.5 Crore grant for clusters up to 500 artisans
Up to ₹5 Crore grant for major clusters with over 500 artisans
simple_benefits: Government builds common machinery centers for artisan groups
90% to 100% grant funding for modern tools, designs, and training
Direct marketing support at national exhibitions
required_documents: Artisan Group / NGO / Trust Registration Certificate
List of Participating Artisans with Aadhaar details
Land availability proof for Common Facility Centre

application_steps.title: Form Nodal/Implementing Agency
application_steps.description: Form registered artisan SPV, NGO, or Government agency.

application_steps.title: Submit Concept Proposal
application_steps.description: Submit proposal on SFURTI portal (sfurti.msme.gov.in).

application_steps.title: DPR Approval by Nodal Agency
application_steps.description: KVIC/COIR Board reviews and approves Cluster DPR.

application_steps.title: Establishment of Common Facility Centre
application_steps.description: Sanction of grant and construction of shared machinery unit.

name: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
description: Sets up Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI) and Technology Business Incubators (TBI) to create new jobs and promote agro-rural entrepreneurship.
simple_description: Government scheme providing training, incubation, machinery, and seed funds to start innovative agro-based and rural enterprises.
max_assistance_text: LBI Grant up to ₹1 Crore, One-time seed capital up to ₹1 Crore
benefits: 100% grant assistance up to ₹1 Crore for setting up Livelihood Incubators (LBI)
Seed capital assistance up to ₹1 Crore for innovative rural startups
Hands-on technical training on modern agro-processing machinery
simple_benefits: Free practical training on modern food processing and farm machinery
Seed money support to start rural innovation businesses
Access to incubator machinery without buying equipment yourself

application_steps.title: Identify Nearest LBI / TBI Centre
application_steps.description: Locate ASPIRE incubator center via MSME portal.

application_steps.title: Submit Rural Innovation Idea
application_steps.description: Apply for incubation training and business guidance.

application_steps.title: Training & Prototype Development
application_steps.description: Utilize LBI machinery for production and testing.

application_steps.title: Seed Capital Grant Sanction
application_steps.description: Receive seed capital grant for commercial launch.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
description: Provides financial, technical, and business support for upgrading existing micro food processing units and establishing new individual/group units under ODOP.
simple_description: Scheme for small food processing businesses (pickle, spices, flour, snacks, fruit items) offering 35% credit-linked subsidy up to ₹10 Lakhs.
max_assistance_text: 35% Credit-linked Subsidy up to ₹10 Lakhs per unit
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of eligible project cost up to ₹10 Lakhs
Seed capital of ₹40,000 per SHG member for working capital and small tools
Grant support for One District One Product (ODOP) branding & marketing
Free FSSAI registration and food safety technical training
simple_benefits: Government pays 35% of your food processing machinery loan (up to ₹10 Lakh gift)
₹40,000 seed grant for women SHG food makers
Free FSSAI food license assistance and product packaging help
required_documents: Proof of Ownership / Lease of Food Unit
Bank Account statement of last 6 months
Detailed Project Report (DPR) for food processing unit

application_steps.title: Register on PMFME Portal
application_steps.description: Visit pmfme.mofpi.gov.in and create user ID.

application_steps.title: Fill Online Application
application_steps.description: Select ODOP product category and enter project details.

application_steps.title: District Resource Person (DRP) Assistance
application_steps.description: DRP helps in DPR preparation and bank loan filing.

application_steps.title: Bank Sanction & Subsidy Credit
application_steps.description: Bank sanctions loan and 35% subsidy is transferred to subsidy account.

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
description: Concessional finance fund to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Castes who are orienting towards innovation and growth.
simple_description: Venture capital funding and equity support up to ₹15 Crore for Scheduled Caste (SC) entrepreneurs starting scalable companies.
max_assistance_text: Financial assistance from ₹20 Lakhs up to ₹15 Crore
benefits: Equity / Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) investment up to ₹15 Crore
Low concessional interest rate of 4% to 8% per annum
Promoters holding requirement: Minimum 51% SC ownership in company
Long term tenure up to 7 years with moratorium
simple_benefits: Get big capital funding from ₹20 Lakh up to ₹15 Crore for SC-owned companies
Very low interest rate between 4% and 8%
7 years repayment tenure
required_documents: Detailed Business Plan & Financial Audit Reports
PAN Card & Aadhaar of SC Directors

application_steps.title: Incorporate Company (Pvt Ltd / LLP)
application_steps.description: Ensure at least 51% equity held by SC promoters.

application_steps.title: Submit Proposal on IFCI VCF-SC Portal
application_steps.description: Visit vcfsc.in and upload pitch deck and business plan.

application_steps.title: Due Diligence by IFCI
application_steps.description: IFCI conducts financial appraisal and site verification.

application_steps.title: Sanction & Investment Disbursement
application_steps.description: VCF-SC disburses equity / loan capital into company bank account.

name: NSFDC Term Loan & Micro Credit Schemes
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
description: Provides concessional loans to SC persons living below double the poverty line for income-generating self-employment projects.
simple_description: Low-interest loan scheme specifically for Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals to start small shops, transport, or service businesses at 6% interest.
max_assistance_text: Term loans up to ₹50 Lakhs at 6% interest rate
benefits: Term Loan up to ₹50 Lakhs for unit establishment at 6% interest rate
Micro Credit Scheme (MCS) up to ₹140,000 at 5% interest rate
Mahila Samriddhi Yojana up to ₹140,000 for SC women at 4% interest rate
Repayment tenure up to 5 to 10 years including moratorium
simple_benefits: Low interest rate between 4% and 6% for SC business owners
Loans up to ₹50 Lakh for large units and ₹1.4 Lakh for small micro-shops
Special discount interest rate for SC women
required_documents: SC Caste Certificate issued by competent authority

application_steps.title: Approach State Channelizing Agency (SCA)
application_steps.description: Visit State SC Development Corporation office or RRB bank.

application_steps.title: Submit NSFDC Application Form
application_steps.description: Attach caste proof, income certificate, and project proposal.

application_steps.title: SCA Appraisal & Forwarding
application_steps.description: State agency verifies credentials and sanctions loan.

application_steps.title: Loan Disbursement at Concessional Rate
application_steps.description: Funds disbursed at 4%-6% interest rate.

name: NSTFDC Term Loan & Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA)
description: Provides concessional financial assistance to Scheduled Tribes (ST) for setting up self-employment ventures in agriculture, trade, and industry.
simple_description: Exclusive cheap loan scheme for Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals and women giving loans up to ₹50 Lakhs at 4% to 6% interest.
max_assistance_text: Loans up to ₹50 Lakhs (Term Loan) / ₹2 Lakhs (Adivasi Mahila Yojana at 4%)
benefits: Term Loan up to ₹50 Lakhs at concessional interest rate of 6%
Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana loan up to ₹2 Lakhs for ST women at 4% interest
Micro Credit Scheme up to ₹1.5 Lakhs per individual at 5% interest
Up to 90% project cost financed by NSTFDC
simple_benefits: 90% of your business project cost funded by government
Super low 4% interest rate for ST women entrepreneurs
Loans up to ₹50 Lakhs with 5 years repayment time
required_documents: ST Tribe Certificate issued by Tehsildar / District Magistrate

application_steps.title: Visit State Tribal Development Corporation
application_steps.description: Contact State Channelizing Agency (SCA) for ST development.

application_steps.title: Fill NSTFDC Application Form
application_steps.description: Submit ST proof, income certificate, and business quote.

application_steps.title: SCA Sanction & Fund Release
application_steps.description: Agency inspects unit and releases concessional credit.

name: NBCFDC Term Loan & Swarnima Scheme for OBC Women
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
description: Provides concessional financial assistance to eligible Other Backward Classes (OBC) for starting self-employment enterprises.
simple_description: Concessional bank loan scheme for OBC business owners giving loans up to ₹15 Lakhs at 6% interest and ₹2 Lakhs at 5% for OBC women.
max_assistance_text: Term Loan up to ₹15 Lakhs at 6% / Swarnima Yojana up to ₹2 Lakhs at 5%
benefits: General Term Loan up to ₹15 Lakhs per beneficiary at 6% interest rate
Swarnima Scheme for OBC Women up to ₹2 Lakhs per beneficiary at 5% interest rate
Micro Finance Scheme up to ₹1.25 Lakhs per individual at 5% interest
Finances up to 85-90% of project cost
simple_benefits: Government covers up to 90% of your business loan cost
OBC women get loans up to ₹2 Lakh at only 5% interest rate
Comfortable repayment terms up to 8 years
required_documents: OBC Caste Certificate issued by competent authority

application_steps.title: Apply at State OBC Finance Corporation
application_steps.description: Visit State Backward Classes Development Corporation.

application_steps.title: Submit Application with Documents
application_steps.description: Provide OBC certificate, income certificate, and project details.

application_steps.title: Sanction & Concessional Disbursement
application_steps.description: Receive loan at 5%-6% interest rate.

name: NMDFC Term Loan & Virasat Scheme for Minorities
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs (MoMA)
description: Provides concessional loan schemes to notified religious minority communities for self-employment and artisan crafts.
simple_description: Concessional low-interest loan scheme for Minority community entrepreneurs (Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Jains, Buddhists, Parsis) up to ₹20 Lakhs at 6%.
max_assistance_text: Term Loan up to ₹20 Lakhs (Credit Line 1 at 6% / Line 2 at 8%)
benefits: Credit Line 1 (Income < ₹98k Rural / ₹1.2L Urban): Loans up to ₹20 Lakhs at 6% interest
Credit Line 2 (Income up to ₹6 Lakhs): Loans up to ₹30 Lakhs for males at 8%, females at 6%
Virasat Scheme for Minority Artisans: Loans up to ₹10 Lakhs at 5% interest rate
Mahila Samriddhi Scheme for Minority Women micro-credit up to ₹1 Lakh at 4%
simple_benefits: Low interest loans (4% to 6%) for minority business owners and artisans
Loans up to ₹20 Lakhs for general business and ₹10 Lakhs for traditional crafts
Special cheap credit rates for minority women
required_documents: Self-Declaration of Minority Religion / Community Proof

application_steps.title: Approach State Channelizing Agency (SCA)
application_steps.description: Contact State Minority Financial Corporation.

application_steps.title: Fill NMDFC Application Form
application_steps.description: Attach minority declaration, income certificate, and project proposal.

application_steps.title: SCA Processing & Loan Disbursement
application_steps.description: Receive loan funds directly into bank account.

name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Scheme (NHFDC Self-Employment)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
description: Provides concessional loans to Persons with Disabilities (PwD) for setting up self-employment ventures, shops, and micro-enterprises.
simple_description: Special loan scheme for Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) giving business loans up to ₹50 Lakhs at cheap interest rates (5% to 9%).
max_assistance_text: Concessional loans up to ₹50 Lakhs (5% to 9% interest)
benefits: Loans up to ₹50,000 at 5% interest per annum
Loans above ₹50,000 up to ₹5 Lakhs at 6% interest per annum
Loans above ₹5 Lakhs up to ₹15 Lakhs at 7% interest per annum
Special 1% rebate in interest rate for Divyangjan Women entrepreneurs
simple_benefits: Very cheap interest rates (5% to 7%) for persons with disability
Additional 1% discount in interest rate for disabled women
Loans up to ₹50 Lakhs to start any micro-business or shop
required_documents: Disability Certificate (UDID Card showing 40% or more disability)

application_steps.title: Apply at State Channelizing Agency or Bank
application_steps.description: Approach State PwD Corporation or public bank.

application_steps.title: Submit Application & UDID Card
application_steps.description: Attach UDID disability certificate and project estimate.

application_steps.title: Sanction & Rebated Credit Release
application_steps.description: Receive loan disbursement with interest rebate.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (DPIIT)
description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market entry and commercialization.
simple_description: Government grant up to ₹20 Lakhs and debt funding up to ₹50 Lakhs for innovative early-stage startups.
max_assistance_text: Grant up to ₹20 Lakhs (Proof of Concept) + Debt up to ₹50 Lakhs
benefits: Grant up to ₹20 Lakhs for validation of Proof of Concept, prototype development, and product trials
Investment up to ₹50 Lakhs for market entry, commercialization, or scale-up through convertible debentures or debt
No collateral required for seed fund support
Disbursement through selected incubator partners across India
simple_benefits: Free grant up to ₹20 Lakhs to build your prototype product
Additional ₹50 Lakhs loan funding to launch and market your business
Zero collateral or home security needed
required_documents: Incorporation Certificate (Pvt Ltd / LLP incorporated within 2 years)
PAN Card & Aadhaar of Founder Directors

application_steps.title: Get DPIIT Recognition
application_steps.description: Register startup on startupindia.gov.in and obtain DPIIT certificate.

application_steps.title: Apply on SISFS Portal
application_steps.description: Log into seedfund.startupindia.gov.in and choose incubator.

application_steps.title: Incubator Pitching & Selection
application_steps.description: Present prototype idea before incubator selection committee.

application_steps.title: Grant & Debt Disbursement
application_steps.description: Incubator sanctions seed grant directly to startup bank account.

name: SAMARTH Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
description: Demand-driven placement-oriented skilling program to incentivize and supplement the efforts of the industry in creating jobs in organized textile and unorganized handicraft sectors.
simple_description: Free skill training and job/business placement scheme for weavers, tailors, and textile workers with stipend and certified credentials.
max_assistance_text: 100% Free Skill Training + Toolkits + Wage Placement
benefits: 100% free NSQF-aligned skill training in textile, weaving, and garmenting trades
Aadhaar-enabled biometric attendance and certified assessment
Guaranteed wage placement assistance or self-employment credit linkage
Special focus on women, SC/ST, and traditional handloom workers
simple_benefits: Completely free professional training in tailoring, weaving, and fabric production
Government certificate recognized across India
Direct job placement or help in getting loans for opening tailoring shops

application_steps.title: Locate SAMARTH Training Centre
application_steps.description: Search accredited training center on samarth-texmin.gov.in.

application_steps.title: Enroll in Textile Skill Trade
application_steps.description: Submit Aadhaar and select course (Apparel, Weaving, Handicraft).

application_steps.title: Complete Training & Assessment
application_steps.description: Attend practical biometric classes and pass assessment.

application_steps.title: Placement / Entrepreneur Support
application_steps.description: Receive job placement or self-employment loan handholding.

name: NSKFDC Swachhta Udyami Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
